```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. 读数据 ----
dat <- read.csv("Data/Summary/all_scores_clean.csv", na.strings = c("NA", ""))   # 路径按你的实际位置改，或先 setwd()

tasks <- c("TLetter", "TGabor", "TPi", "SLetter", "SGabor", "SPi",
           "OSpan", "CSpan", "Corsi", "Matrix")
dat[tasks] <- lapply(dat[tasks], as.numeric)

colSums(is.na(dat[tasks]))          # 每列的 NA 数

# prcomp 不能处理 NA，这里删掉有 NA 的被试（listwise deletion）
dat_cc <- dat[complete.cases(dat[tasks]), ]
cat("N used:", nrow(dat_cc), "of", nrow(dat), "\n")

# ---- 2. PCA（基于相关矩阵）----
pca <- prcomp(dat_cc[tasks], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# 每个 PC 的方差占比
var_exp <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
pc_names <- paste0("PC", seq_along(var_exp))
var_tab <- data.frame(PC = pc_names,
                      eigenvalue = pca$sdev^2,
                      var_explained = var_exp,
                      cumulative = cumsum(var_exp))
print(var_tab, digits = 3)

# loading = 变量与 PC 的相关（心理学里常用的 loading）
# 如果想要特征向量系数，直接用 loadings <- pca$rotation
loadings <- sweep(pca$rotation, 2, pca$sdev, "*")

# PC 的正负号是任意的：让每个 PC 的 loading 之和为正，方便解读（可删）
flip <- sign(colSums(loadings)); flip[flip == 0] <- 1
loadings <- sweep(loadings, 2, flip, "*")
print(round(loadings, 3))

# ---- 3. 图1：每个 direction 的方差占比（scree plot）----
scree <- data.frame(PC = factor(pc_names, levels = pc_names),
                    var = var_exp, cum = cumsum(var_exp))

p_scree <- ggplot(scree, aes(PC, var)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(var, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum, group = 1), colour = "grey30") +
  geom_point(aes(y = cum), colour = "grey30") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Variance explained",
       title = "Variance explained by each PC (line = cumulative)") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_scree)

# ---- 4. 图2：每个 task 在每个 PC 上的 loading ----
load_long <- data.frame(
  task    = rep(rownames(loadings), times = ncol(loadings)),
  PC      = rep(colnames(loadings), each  = nrow(loadings)),
  loading = as.vector(loadings)
)
load_long$task <- factor(load_long$task, levels = rev(tasks))
load_long$PC   <- factor(load_long$PC, levels = pc_names,
                         labels = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", pc_names, var_exp * 100))

# 柱状图：每个 PC 一个 panel
p_load <- ggplot(load_long, aes(loading, task, fill = loading > 0)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ PC, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x = "Loading", y = NULL, title = "Task loadings on each PC") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_load)

# 热图：一张图看完所有 PC
p_heat <- ggplot(load_long, aes(PC, task, fill = loading)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", loading)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "firebrick", mid = "white", high = "steelblue",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Loading heatmap") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p_heat)

# ---- 5. 保存（可选）----
ggsave("pca_scree.png",    p_scree, width = 6,  height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("pca_loadings.png", p_load,  width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("pca_heatmap.png",  p_heat,  width = 8,  height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
